mapper.select: SELECT id, region_code, notification_id, vin_list, notification_send_list, registration_serial_number, sequence_number, is_linked, is_deleted, created, updated FROM notification_vin_list WHERE registration_serial_number = #{registrationSerialNumber} AND is_linked = #{isLinked};
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_vin_list SET is_linked = #{isLinked}, updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE registration_serial_number = #{registrationSerialNumber} AND sequence_number = #{sequenceNumber}
